title: Fellowship OpenCode Configuration
description: Configuration for @unfrgivn/opencode-config — the Fellowship OpenCode plugin that syncs bundled assets on startup. Place this file at .opencode/fellowship.json (or .jsonc) in your project, or at ~/.config/opencode/fellowship.json globally. User config loads first, project config is merged on top, and .jsonc wins over .json within the same directory.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema for editor autocompletion.

disable.description: Asset disable list. Entries can be typed ("skill:example"), untyped ("example"), glob patterns ("skill:deprecated-*"), or negated ("!skill:keep-this"). Later entries override earlier ones.

agentOverrides.description: Partial patch-style overrides applied to bundled agent configs before injection. Use this to change specific values (for example temperature) without redefining the whole agent. Built-in bundled agents accept either descriptive or LOTR names as keys (for example `planner` or `treebeard`). Local opencode.json agent entries still take precedence and fully replace the bundled agent config.

additionalProperties.description: Partial agent config patch for a bundled agent name.

permission.description: Permission config. Supports full replacement of top-level keys; nested objects merge with bundled defaults during apply.

policy.description: Per-agent policy controls for bundled agents. Tools and permission merge into the bundled agent before injection. MCP and skill entries synthesize permission rules; prefix an entry with ! to deny it.

permission.description: Additional permission rules to merge into the bundled agent before injection.

mcps.description: MCP allow/deny list for this agent. Example: ["context7", "!chrome-devtools"]. Positive entries make an allowlist for known bundled MCPs; deny-only entries make a blocklist. Use * for all discovered bundled MCPs.

skills.description: Skill allow/deny list for this agent. Example: ["*", "!terraform"]. Positive entries make an allowlist; deny-only entries make a blocklist.

installMethod.description: How skills, plugins, and MCPs are installed locally. "link" creates symlinks (default, faster, auto-updates with package). "copy" creates independent copies.

agentNames.description: Agent naming theme. "descriptive" uses role-based names (orchestrator, explorer, etc.). "lotr" uses Tolkien character names (gandalf, legolas, etc.).

dryRun.description: When true, analyzes what would change without writing any files. Useful for previewing sync behavior.

preset.description: Default named preset to apply on startup. Runtime selection from /preset or FELLOWSHIP_PRESET takes precedence.

presets.description: Named runtime-safe preset overlays. Presets can override agent models and orchestration settings, then apply on the next OpenCode restart.

fast.description: Use cheaper/faster models for routine work.

models.description: Override the model used by bundled agents. Built-in bundled agents accept either descriptive or LOTR names as keys (for example `orchestrator` or `gandalf`), regardless of the active naming theme. Omitted agents or empty string values fall back to the plugin default.

companion.description: Optional desktop companion integration. When enabled, Fellowship writes a companion state file and launches a managed, custom, or bundled companion binary. The bundled macOS companion opens a chromeless desktop image tile for busy or waiting agents and animates through SNES-style named sprite panels. Companion labels and art follow the top-level agentNames theme.

enabled.description: Enable companion state updates and best-effort binary launch.

binaryPath.description: Path to a custom companion binary to launch. If omitted, Fellowship checks its managed storage path, then falls back to the bundled companion binary.

orchestration.description: Orchestration runtime configuration for delegation admission, concurrency, provider backpressure, recovery, and tmux integration.

providerMode.description: Default provider routing mode for subagent tasks.

vision.description: Enable the vision multimodal analysis tool.

selfHealing.description: Enable provider congestion backpressure. Failed task calls are not automatically retried.

limits.description: Concurrency, retry, and timeout limits for delegated tasks.

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum number of concurrent delegated subagent tasks in one parent OpenCode session.

maxConcurrentGlobal.description: Maximum concurrent delegated tasks across local OpenCode processes sharing this cache.

providerMaxConcurrent.description: Optional local concurrent task caps by provider. Omitted providers use maxConcurrentGlobal.

maxRetries.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. The runtime does not automatically retry task calls.

retryBackoffMs.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. The runtime does not schedule retry attempts.

runtimeFallback.description: Provider congestion backpressure settings plus backward-compatible legacy fallback fields. The runtime does not replay or retry task calls.

enabled.description: Enable shared provider congestion cooldown and capacity reduction.

retryOnErrors.description: HTTP status codes eligible for provider handling. Congestion codes 408, 429, 503, and 504 trigger cooldown and capacity reduction.

maxFallbackAttempts.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. No fallback task call is automatically scheduled.

cooldownSeconds.description: Shared provider cooldown in seconds after an eligible congestion failure.

timeoutSeconds.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. No fallback task call is automatically scheduled.

notifyOnFallback.description: Deprecated compatibility setting retained for existing configs.

providerOrder.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. Provider routing uses providerMode and categories.routing; failed task calls are not replayed.

hooks.description: Hook configuration for orchestration lifecycle events.

disabled.description: List of hook names to disable.

telemetry.description: Enable telemetry counters for hook invocations.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of notifications to retain.

categories.description: Per-category overrides for provider routing and concurrency limits. Category names are free-form strings (normalized to lowercase at runtime).

routing.description: Map of category name to provider mode. Overrides the top-level providerMode for tasks in that category.

maxConcurrent.description: Map of category name to max concurrent tasks. Overrides the top-level limits.maxConcurrent for that category.

recovery.description: Startup recovery configuration for orphaned tasks from prior sessions.

autoResumeOnStart.description: Check persisted tasks on startup. Live-owner work stays active; abandoned or legacy queued/retrying work becomes terminal interrupted because task calls cannot be replayed safely.

tmux.description: Tmux session management for subagent tasks. Each OpenCode session gets a dedicated tmux session, and each subagent task gets its own window.

enabled.description: Enable tmux session management. Requires tmux to be installed.

mode.description: Where delegated task terminals appear. window keeps Fellowship's dedicated agent-session windows; pane splits the current tmux window and applies layout/mainPaneSize for oh-my-opencode-slim style multiplexer parity.

layout.description: Tmux layout applied after opening or closing task panes when mode is pane. Mirrors slim's tmux multiplexer layout options.

mainPaneSize.description: Main pane percentage for main-horizontal/main-vertical layouts when mode is pane. Equivalent to slim's main_pane_size.

sessionPrefix.description: Prefix for tmux session names. Sessions are named {prefix}-{opencode-session-id}.
